description: List the detailed reports built in your workspace, newest first. A report packages one or more load-test runs as downloadable files. Each has a reportId, name, kind, loadTestRunIds, packs (data, excel, pdf), includeAudio, status (pending, running, ready or failed), progress while building, counts (runs, calls, steps, recordings), files once ready (pack, file name, size) and error if it failed. Takes optional `limit` and `cursor` (nextCursor from the previous page; absent on the last page). Use when: the user asks what reports exist or whether one is ready. The files are downloaded in the web app; no link is given here. Read-only. Needs testing:read.
name: listReports

nextCursor.description: Present only when more reports remain.

files.description: The built files. Empty until `status` is `ready`.

title: List Detailed Reports
